snippet.title: Future Vibe Check | Secret Sauce Showcase trailer
snippet.description:
Learn more about Future Vibe Check https://store.steampowered.com/app/3525890/Future_Vibe_Check/

Future Vibe Check is a musical automation game where your factories don’t just produce goods—they make music. Summoned by Infinity, you must rebuild reality. The call of endless optimization will be sublimated into sound. Automate the Vibe. Defend the Vibe. Become the Vibe. Meditation Mode allows you to continue the vibe no matter where you are in your spiritual journey. Automate your musical factory into the prime beat making and boxing machine it was always meant to be. 

Follow news and updates on the Secret Sauce Showcase:
http://obp.gg/secretsauce
Twitter: https://x.com/offbrand_games
BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/offbrand.games
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@offbrand-games

offbrand games is partnering with Open Sauce to celebrate all things indie gaming with Secret Sauce! Expect two days (streamed & in-person) of game exhibitions, talks + roundtables from industry voices, and competitions hosted by gaming creators - as well as a premiere trailer showcase with announcements from a bevy of indie developers and publishers.

Learn more about Open Sauce: https://opensauce.com/overview/
